/about.text: About Us Welcome to the Duelers Guild Where cards are cast like spells, dice decide destinies, and every player is a hero in the making. In the bustling heart of Tracy, CA , nestled between realms both magical and modern, stands the Duelers Guild —a sanctuary for adventurers, duelists, and collectors alike. Born from a shared passion for trading card games, fantasy lore, and camaraderie, our guild is more than a shop—it’s a stronghold for the community. Within our halls, you’ll find a trove of treasures: Spell-forged trading cards from across the multiverse Mighty miniature games where strategy meets storytelling Wondrous dice, arcane accessories, and enchanted supplies Weekly tournaments, casual battles, and legendary events Knowledgeable guildmasters (aka staff) ready to guide your quest Whether you're a battle-hardened planeswalker, a warlord commanding legions in a tabletop skirmish, a new initiate learning the rules of the realm, or a dungeon-crawling party leader picking up last-minute loot before game night, the Duelers Guild welcomes all. Our mission is simple: To provide a magical, welcoming space where all adventurers can gather, play, and grow their power—one duel or campaign at a time. So grab your gear, ready your deck or warband, and step into the Guild. Your next adventure awaits. Contact Us 2096994106 support@duelersguild.com Location - US 104 W 11th Street , Tracy, CA 95376 View the map Store Hours - Pacific Time (US & Canada) Mon - Fri 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM Closed Wednesdays Sat 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM Sun 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM × Skip footer

/store_policies.text: Store Policies Return Policy – The Pact of Good Faith At Duelers Guild , we stand by the honor of our trade. If a magical item (product) you receive does not match its description or arrives cursed (damaged/defective), we will gladly accept its return. Returns: Most new, unopened relics sold and fulfilled by Duelers Guild may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund of your gold (purchase price). Should the error be ours (you received the wrong enchanted item, or one arrived damaged by goblins), we shall pay the return shipping as well. Refund Policy – Restoration of Gold Refunds are cast after we receive and inspect the returned item in our vaults. Expect your gold to return within four weeks of handing your package to the local courier. In many cases, it will arrive sooner. This time includes: 5–10 business days for the courier’s return voyage 3–5 business days for the Guildmasters to inspect and process the relic The time your local bank takes to complete the transfer spell We shall notify you by magical scroll (email) once your refund has been issued. Privacy Policy – The Guild’s Vow of Secrecy Duelers Guild is sworn to protect your personal scrolls and secrets. We only collect information needed to fulfill your orders and guide you through your journey. What We Gather: When you place an order or join a quest (promotion/contest), we may ask for: Your name, e-mail address, address, and payment info Your consent to receive enchanted scrolls (newsletters) about sales, quests, and magical announcements When you shop online, you are automatically enlisted into our mailing list, sent through the powerful spell service of ConstantContact. You may opt out at any time—no dispel magic required. How We Protect Your Information: We use a Secure Server Layer (SSL) to encrypt all your personal and financial data. All sensitive customer information is kept under strict magical lock and ward (digital security). What About Cookies? While some sites plant cookies in your travel pack, we do not use cookies to gather or store personal data. Your journey remains your own. Sharing with Allies and Enforcement Duelers Guild does not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third-party warlocks or merchants. We may share general statistics (number of quests completed, popular artifacts) with reputable partners—but never anything personally identifying. We may, in rare cases, disclose information if required to: Obey the King’s Law (legal compliance) Enforce our Guild Charter (terms and conditions) Protect the Guild’s sanctity, members, and allies In Summary Your trust is sacred to us. We vow to protect your information, honor your returns, and always conduct ourselves as a lawful good establishment. Your Consent By shopping at Duelers Guild (online or in-person), you agree to the collection and use of your information as described in this scroll. If changes are made to this policy, you will find them here. Please note: we may offer portals to allied sites (affiliates). Once you leave our realm, their laws govern your data. We are not responsible for how other realms handle your information. × Skip footer
